## Body

The real installed-SDK canary proposed in the earlier SDK note now exists: `just copilot-sdk-contract` (#259). Run without `--record` for review. Observed runs passed all seven checks, left the version-record blob unchanged and created no target/. This proves the installed version only. The child inherits ambient environment, including NODE_OPTIONS and credentials; temporary daemon/seat isolation is not a credential sandbox.

Never run `just update-copilot` or real `copilot update` to validate a review: it changes the shared fleet CLI. Use authorized stubs instead. The updater intentionally invokes the contract with --record; #261 binds success to both report.version and report.verified matching the installed post-update version, not exit status alone.

OMP's `config get worktree.clone --json` is not provably global-state read-only: the installed handler initializes settings/storage and may perform migrations or marker writes. Project-only .omp/config.yml and no global symlink do not eliminate those incidental writes. Under a no-global-mutation instruction, do not invoke the live sensor; record static-only proof and the caveat (#260).
